title: San Francisco Gin Cocktail Class with Bay Views | Gold Bar
blurb:
Discover a bright, social cocktail experience that feels distinctly San Francisco.

Hosted inside Gold Bar Distillery’s 1930s Art Deco Pan Am hangar on Treasure Island, this hands-on class pairs creative mixology with sweeping views of the Bay and San Francisco skyline.

The experience highlights Pacific House Gin, crafted by Gold Bar Distillery and known for its vibrant botanicals, fresh citrus, and smooth, approachable character.

Guests shake, stir, and garnish three colorful cocktails while learning how botanicals shape flavor and balance. One of the moments guests love most is seeing the first cocktail come together, a bright, beautifully balanced drink they just made themselves.

Even guests who normally don’t reach for gin often leave surprised by how refreshing and enjoyable these cocktails can be.

Getting here is easy, including a scenic six-minute ferry ride from the San Francisco Ferry Building.

Pacific House Gin is the Official Gin of Bay FC.
